investigations.summary: RTA PMM-T2173/T2174: the case-insensitive 'rta' filter matched a MongoDB hello command's base64 signature (z6YIJqRtajW...). Reproduced on Linode; fixed with unique labels and an 'rta-overview-' filter.

PMM-T1090: the test detoured through Inventory, where left-nav links drop the dashboard time zone (timezone=browser). Main failed 5/6 on Linode, fix passed 9/9. Open question: should the time zone survive a non-dashboard page?

nightly / ha: Helm install fails (vmauth.yaml b64dec) because the orchestrator passes HELM_CHART_BRANCH=main, and pmm3-ha-eks only works with PMM-HA-GA since jenkins-pipelines#4479. Jenkins config, not PMM; the fix is one line at pmm3-nightly-orchestrator.groovy:208.
